profile.headline: Sr. Software Engineer at Nationwide
profile.summary:
I have graduated from Arizona State University with a bachelor's of science in Applied Computing, and I am ready to pursue my dreams of working  with data, security, and good practices to bring good software to the world. Even after obtaining my degree, I hope to grow and learn from all my future experiences, and I would love to become an even better person as a result.

I like to use programming languages like Python and Java for my personal hobbies, such as name that tune, to give attendees of my panels a fun time.

projects.title: Name that Video Game Tune (Java Edition)
projects.description: A program for hosting trivia panels across Gaming conventions. Used to provide a gamified version of Name that Tune for Video Games, Anime, Cartoons, and Pop Culture to show off attendees knowledge at the event.

projects.title: BullyBlocker
projects.description: There is inevitably an epidemic of cyberbullying amongst adolescents. Unfortunately, we have not encountered sufficient research on the automatic identification of cyberbullying behavior in social networks, particularly in Facebook. BullyBlocker is a Facebook application designed to exploit social media data and, based off of a model built on previous research findings in areas of traditional and cyberbullying in adolescents, to then identify an instance of cyberbullying and notify the parents.
